bio.text: James Kaufman, a Republican, represents District F in the Alaska Senate; the senator served in the Alaska House of Representatives in 2021-2022 and has been a state senator since 2023, according to the Alaska Legislature.
The legislative biography says Kaufman worked in Alaska as a resource projects quality manager and team lead on North Slope capital projects until retiring in 2017.
Kaufman lives on the Anchorage Hillside, has been active in community councils and the Hillside Home and Landowners Organization, and first ran for public office in 2020, per the same biography.
